senses.en: to decide firmly; to find out
To control or strongly influence what happens.
To make a firm decision to do something.

ex.en: Tests help determine your progress.
ex.zh: 测试有助于测定你的进步。

ex.en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
ex.zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。

tip: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

senses.en: a thin thread, or the part of food that helps digestion

ex.en: Oats add fibre to breakfast.
ex.zh: 燕麦给早餐增加纤维。

ex.en: Cotton fibre and dietary fibre share a name, but one is cloth and the other is part of what you eat.
ex.zh: 棉纤维和膳食纤维共用一个名字，但一个是布料，一个是食物里的成分。

tip: fibre 是英式。美式 fiber 已在库里。膳食纤维 dietary fibre 通常不可数。

senses.en: not guilty; pure
Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life.
Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.

ex.en: The child looked innocent.
ex.zh: 孩子看上去很天真。

ex.en: A fair legal system must protect innocent people while ensuring that those responsible for crimes face justice.
ex.zh: 公平的法律制度必须保护无辜者，同时确保犯罪者受到法律制裁。

col: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪
tip: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

senses.en: a shop selling food and household goods

ex.en: We stopped at the grocery for milk and eggs.
ex.zh: 我们在杂货店停下，买了牛奶和鸡蛋。

ex.en: The grocery on the corner closes at nine, later than the school canteen.
ex.zh: 拐角的杂货店九点关门，比学校食堂晚。

tip: 参考表没有单独的 grocery。常见说法是 a grocery 或 a grocery store，卖食品和日用品。

senses.en: based on chance or personal wish, not on a fair reason

ex.en: The order of names looked arbitrary.
ex.zh: 名单的顺序看起来很随意。

ex.en: An arbitrary rule that ignores the written guide will be hard for the class to accept.
ex.zh: 一条不顾书面说明、只凭武断的规定，全班很难接受。

tip: arbitrary 强调没有正当理由。random 只是随机，不一定武断。副词是 arbitrarily。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: The view from the old tower was superb.
ex.zh: 旧塔上的景色好极了。

ex.en: Reviewers called the performance superb, and the choir was asked to sing it again.
ex.zh: 评论称演出极好，合唱团被请来再唱一遍。

tip: superb 语气很强，比 good 高一档。重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a surprising chance happening

ex.en: It was a coincidence that we wore the same tie.
ex.zh: 我们系了同一条领带，纯属巧合。

ex.en: By coincidence both stories begin on a rainy night in a station, though the writers never met.
ex.zh: 巧合的是两个故事都始于车站的雨夜，尽管两位作者从未见过面。

tip: by coincidence 作状语。不要说 a coincidence chance。

senses.en: a narrow street or path between buildings

ex.en: The bakery is down a narrow alley.
ex.zh: 面包店在一条窄巷里。

ex.en: Lights were added in the alley so students could walk home without crossing the main road.
ex.zh: 巷子里加了灯，学生回家就不必穿过大路。

tip: 小巷是 alley。盲巷、死胡同是 a blind alley，也可比喻行不通的办法。

senses.en: the height of something above sea level

ex.en: The town sits at a high altitude.
ex.zh: 这座小镇海拔很高。

ex.en: At that altitude the air is thin, so the team walked slowly and drank more water.
ex.zh: 那个高度空气稀薄，队伍走得慢，水也喝得更多。

col: at an altitude of｜在…的高度
tip: altitude 多指海拔。态度是 attitude，只差一个字母。

senses.en: the main points of something, or its outer shape
to give the main points

ex.en: An outline comes first, then the full essay.
ex.zh: 先有大纲，再写全文。

ex.en: The teacher outlined the chapter in five points, then left us to read the examples.
ex.zh: 老师用五点概述了这一章，然后让我们自己读例子。

tip: 名词 outline 是提纲或轮廓。动词是「概述」，例句里可用 outlined。

senses.en: words printed under a picture, or on a screen

ex.en: The caption names every person in the photo.
ex.zh: 说明文字写出了照片里的每个人。

ex.en: Turn on the caption if the film is quiet, so the back row can still follow the story.
ex.zh: 电影声音小时打开字幕，后排也能跟上情节。

tip: 图下的说明是 caption。影片字幕也可以说 captions，英式还说 subtitles。

senses.en: to judge the quality or value of something

ex.en: Two teachers assess the oral test together so one opinion does not decide it.
ex.zh: 两位老师一起评定口试，避免一个人说了算。

ex.en: We assess a source by asking who wrote it and whether the date is clear.
ex.zh: 我们评价一份资料，会问是谁写的、日期是否清楚。

tip: assess 是作出评价。名词 assessment。不要和 access（进入）搞混。

senses.en: the country you come from

ex.en: She wrote poems about her homeland.
ex.zh: 她写诗写自己的故乡。

ex.en: He returned to his homeland after university and taught in the school he once attended.
ex.zh: 大学毕业后他回到故乡，在自己曾经就读的学校教书。

col: return to one's homeland｜回到故乡
tip: homeland 可指祖国，也可指故乡那一片土地。

senses.en: not ready or not happy to do something

ex.en: He is unwilling to share the password.
ex.zh: 他不愿意把密码给人。

ex.en: Unwilling helpers slow a group project, so the teacher lets students choose jobs they can accept.
ex.zh: 不情愿的帮手会拖慢小组作业，所以老师让学生选自己能接受的任务。

col: an unwilling helper｜不情愿的帮手
tip: unwilling to do sth，不要说 unwilling doing。副词 unwillingly 已经包含否定，不要再加 not。

senses.en: a sudden feeling of excitement
to make someone feel that

ex.en: The goal gave the crowd a thrill.
ex.zh: 这个进球让观众激动起来。

ex.en: It still thrills her to hear the violin from the stairwell at the end of practice.
ex.zh: 训练结束时从楼梯间听见小提琴，仍然让她激动。

col: the thrill of victory｜胜利时的激动
tip: 人感到激动用 thrilled，事物令人激动用 thrilling。thriller 是惊险故事，不是形容词。

senses.en: to clean a floor with a broom

ex.en: Please sweep the classroom after the party.
ex.zh: 聚会结束后请把教室扫一扫。

ex.en: They sweep the leaves off the path each morning before the gates open.
ex.zh: 他们每天早上开门前把小路上的叶子扫掉。

tip: 过去式和过去分词都是 swept。扫帚是 broom。

senses.en: to make something clearer and easier to understand

ex.en: Could you clarify the second step?
ex.zh: 你能把第二步说清楚吗？

ex.en: The editor asked him to clarify who paid for the trip before the article went into the paper.
ex.zh: 编辑让他在文章见报前说明这次出行是谁出的钱。

tip: clarify 后面接名词。名词 clarification。clear 是形容词，clarify 是动词。

senses.en: a heavy metal object that keeps a boat in place
to lower the anchor

ex.en: The boat dropped its anchor near the wooden dock.
ex.zh: 船在木码头附近抛了锚。

ex.en: They anchored in a shallow bay because the wind was too strong for the open water.
ex.zh: 风太大，不适合去开阔水面，他们在一个浅湾抛了锚。

tip: 参考表是锚、抛锚。新闻主播也叫 anchor，本卡不收。

senses.en: a fastener that joins two edges of cloth

ex.en: The zip on this coat is stuck.
ex.zh: 这件外套的拉链卡住了。

ex.en: Pull the zip slowly, or the cloth will catch and the coat will not close.
ex.zh: 拉链要慢慢拉，不然布会卡住，外套就合不上。

tip: 英式里 zip 常指拉链。美式邮政编码是 zip code。动词 zip up 是拉上拉链。

senses.en: expecting that good things will happen

ex.en: She stays optimistic even when the score is low.
ex.zh: 比分落后时她仍然乐观。

ex.en: An optimistic plan still needs a second bus, in case the first one is full.
ex.zh: 乐观的计划也要留第二辆车，以防第一辆坐满。

tip: optimistic about sth。名词 optimism。反义 pessimistic。

senses.en: an arch of colors in the sky after rain

ex.en: A rainbow stood over the playground after the shower.
ex.zh: 阵雨后一道彩虹挂在操场上空。

ex.en: We stopped the bus to photograph the rainbow, and it faded before everyone was ready.
ex.zh: 我们让车停下拍彩虹，还没等大家都准备好，它就淡了。

tip: rainbow 是一个词。雨后对着太阳的方向才容易看见。

senses.en: excellent, or very impressive to look at

ex.en: What a splendid catch at the back.
ex.zh: 后场这一接太漂亮了。

ex.en: The splendid view from the tower lasted only until clouds covered the far hills.
ex.zh: 塔上的壮丽景色只持续到云挡住远山为止。

tip: splendid 既可以夸景色，也可以夸主意或表现。语气比 good 强。

senses.en: suitable
to take something for your own use without permission
to officially set aside money for a particular purpose

ex.en: Wear appropriate clothes for the interview.
ex.zh: 面试穿合适的衣服。

ex.en: Governments should provide appropriate training to help workers adapt to technological changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 政府应提供适当培训，帮助劳动者适应劳动力市场中的技术变革。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词读/eɪt/。

senses.en: ease of use
Something that makes daily life easier.

ex.en: Online shopping offers great convenience.
ex.zh: 网购提供极大便利。

ex.en: Although online shopping offers convenience, it may encourage unnecessary spending and increase packaging waste.
ex.zh: 虽然网上购物带来了便利，但它可能助长不必要的消费，并增加包装垃圾。

tip: 表示“方便”通常不可数；形容词是convenient。

senses.en: to run somewhere very quickly
a short fast run

ex.en: We dash to the canteen if the break is short.
ex.zh: 课间短的时候，我们冲向食堂。

ex.en: He made a dash for the closing door and still had to wait for the next lift.
ex.zh: 他朝正在关上的门冲过去，结果还是得等下一趟电梯。

tip: dash 是短而快的跑。a dash of 也可以表示少许，参考表这一行是快跑、冲刺。

senses.en: a person who formally asks for a job, place, or grant

ex.en: Each applicant brought a short form.
ex.zh: 每位申请人都带了一张简表。

ex.en: The club reads every applicant with the same checklist, so a famous school name is not an advantage.
ex.zh: 社团用同一张清单看每位申请人，名校名字并不能加分。

tip: applicant 是提出申请的人。apply for 是申请。application 是申请书或申请这个行为。

senses.en: the bright burning gas of a fire

ex.en: Keep your sleeve away from the flame.
ex.zh: 袖子离火焰远一点。

ex.en: The flame turned yellow when the air hole was closed, so we opened it again.
ex.zh: 气孔关上时火焰变黄了，于是我们又打开。

tip: 参考表还写了「光辉」。本卡先记看得见的火焰。

senses.en: older, of people in a family
an older person

ex.en: My elder sister starts university this autumn.
ex.zh: 我姐姐今年秋天上大学。

ex.en: The village elders sat at the front and listened to the students' report.
ex.zh: 村里的长者坐在前排，听学生们的汇报。

tip: 家庭里年长的用 elder：elder sister。更老的物品一般用 older，不用 elder。

senses.en: a result of an action
The quality of being important or worth considering.

ex.en: Every choice has a consequence.
ex.zh: 每个选择都有后果。

ex.en: One serious consequence of rapid urban growth is increased pressure on public transport and housing.
ex.zh: 城市快速扩张的一个严重后果是公共交通和住房承受的压力增大。

tip: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。

senses.en: able to be understood in more than one way

ex.en: The ending is deliberately ambiguous.
ex.zh: 这个结尾是故意写得可以有多种理解的。

ex.en: An ambiguous instruction caused two groups to measure different sides of the same triangle.
ex.zh: 一条有歧义的说明让两个组去量同一个三角形的不同边。

col: an ambiguous sentence｜有歧义的句子
tip: ambiguous 是能有两种理解。vague 只是不清楚。名词 ambiguity。

senses.en: to give money or goods to help

ex.en: Our class donated winter coats to the community center.
ex.zh: 我们班把冬衣捐给了社区中心。

ex.en: She donated the prize money to the library so it could buy more science books.
ex.zh: 她把奖金捐给图书馆，用来多买科学书。

tip: 参考表没有 donate。donate sth to sb/sth。名词 donation。

senses.en: an activity you do for pleasure

ex.en: The recreation room has a piano and two board games.
ex.zh: 娱乐室里有一架钢琴和两套棋牌。

ex.en: Swimming is his only recreation during exams, twenty minutes and then back to the desk.
ex.zh: 考试期间他唯一的消遣是游泳，游二十分钟再回到书桌前。

tip: recreation 是放松的活动。re-creation 加连字符才是「再创造」。

senses.en: a public room where people can sit and relax

ex.en: Passengers wait in the lounge upstairs.
ex.zh: 旅客在楼上的休息室等候。

ex.en: The teachers' lounge has a kettle and a few chairs, but no space for a meeting.
ex.zh: 教师休息室有水壶和几把椅子，但开不了会。

tip: lounge 是可以坐着休息的公共房间。动词 lounge about 是闲荡。

senses.en: not occupied or filled

ex.en: The vacant seat is beside the window.
ex.zh: 空位在窗边。

ex.en: A vacant shop on the corner has been empty since winter, and the sign is still up.
ex.zh: 拐角的空店从冬天起就没人，牌子还挂着。

tip: vacant 常指座位、房间、职位空着。名词 vacancy。人离开腾地方是 vacate。

senses.en: to leave or give up
To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished.
A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.

ex.en: We had to abandon the plan after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后我们不得不放弃那个计划。

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

tip: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。

senses.en: a person walking in the street
for people on foot, or dull

ex.en: A pedestrian waited at the crossing.
ex.zh: 一位行人在人行横道边等着。

ex.en: The pedestrian bridge keeps walkers above the traffic at the school corner.
ex.zh: 天桥让步行的人从学校拐角的车流上方过去。

tip: 行人是 pedestrian。人行横道是 a pedestrian crossing，美式也说 crosswalk。作形容词还可以表示平淡。

senses.en: of the face

ex.en: The facial cream stung the cut on his cheek.
ex.zh: 这款面部乳膏刺痛了他脸颊上的伤口。

ex.en: Facial expressions in the video told us who was nervous before anyone spoke.
ex.zh: 视频里的面部表情在开口之前就告诉了我们谁紧张。

tip: 参考表写「面部用的」，本卡收作形容词「面部的」。face 是名词。

senses.en: a person who has at least a million pounds or dollars

ex.en: The story's millionaire still rides a bicycle.
ex.zh: 故事里的百万富翁仍然骑自行车。

ex.en: Becoming a millionaire is not the aim of the club; paying for the bus is.
ex.zh: 成为百万富翁不是社团的目标，凑齐车费才是。

col: become a millionaire｜成为百万富翁
a millionaire businessman｜百万富翁商人
tip: millionaire 是拥有百万（货币）的人。百万这个数是 million。

senses.en: a place where beer is made

ex.en: The old brewery is now a museum.
ex.zh: 那家旧啤酒厂现在是博物馆。

ex.en: Geography class studied how a riverside brewery uses local water, without suggesting that students should drink.
ex.zh: 地理课研究了河边啤酒厂怎样使用当地的水，并没有暗示学生应当去喝。

tip: brewery 是生产啤酒的工厂。课堂里把它当产业来讲，不鼓励未成年饮酒。动词是 brew。

senses.en: a school for very young children

ex.en: Kindergarten ends at three in this town.
ex.zh: 这个镇的幼儿园三点放学。

ex.en: The kindergarten keeps a spare coat by the door because the children forget theirs.
ex.zh: 幼儿园在门口放一件备用外套，因为孩子们会忘带自己的。

fam: kindergartener (n. 幼儿园小朋友；幼儿教师)
tip: 高考里常把 kindergarten 译成幼儿园。美式多指上一年级前的那一年，大约五岁，不是整个学前阶段。英式幼儿班更常说 nursery。

senses.en: the part of mathematics about shapes and space

ex.en: Geometry homework is on page forty.
ex.zh: 几何作业在第四十页。

ex.en: In geometry we proved that the angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees.
ex.zh: 几何课上我们证明了三角形的内角和是 180 度。

tip: 几何是 geometry。地理是 geography。两词都长，不要看混。

senses.en: easy to understand, or honest and direct

ex.en: The instructions are straightforward.
ex.zh: 这些说明简单明了。

ex.en: Give a straightforward answer about the missing key, even if the truth is awkward.
ex.zh: 丢失的钥匙要坦率回答，哪怕实情让人难堪。

col: a straightforward task｜一项直截了当的任务
tip: straightforward 指不绕弯、好懂。它不是 straight 和 forward 的简单相加，但可以这样帮助记忆。

senses.en: sending out harmful energy from the nucleus of an atom

ex.en: Radioactive samples stay in a locked cupboard.
ex.zh: 放射性样品放在上锁的柜子里。

ex.en: The sign says the waste is radioactive, so students do not open the yellow box.
ex.zh: 牌子写着这些废物有放射性，所以学生不要打开黄盒子。

tip: radioactive 形容物质会放出辐射。名词 radioactivity。课堂只讲标志和安全，不涉及武器。
note: 只收课本里的放射性与安全标志。

senses.en: a sharp curved nail on an animal's foot
to scratch or tear with claws

ex.en: The crab's claw tapped the glass.
ex.zh: 螃蟹的钳子敲了敲玻璃。

ex.en: The cat may claw the curtain if it is shut in, so we leave the door ajar during the visit.
ex.zh: 猫要是被关在里面，可能会抓窗帘，所以参观时我们让门留一条缝。

tip: 蟹钳和猫爪都可以叫 claw。动词 claw at 是抓。例句只讲动物，不讲对人使用。

senses.en: the supply of water to land so crops can grow

ex.en: Irrigation keeps the rice field green.
ex.zh: 灌溉让稻田保持青绿。

ex.en: The village plans new irrigation so dry weeks do not ruin the vegetables along the canal.
ex.zh: 村里计划新建灌溉设施，免得连续干旱毁掉水渠边的蔬菜。

tip: irrigation 是名词，动词是 irrigate。它多作不可数名词。

senses.en: a machine that records sound, or a simple wind instrument

ex.en: The recorder captured the whole interview.
ex.zh: 录音机把整段采访录了下来。

ex.en: In music class the recorder is a wind instrument, not the machine on the shelf.
ex.zh: 音乐课上的 recorder 是竖笛，不是架子上那台机器。

tip: recorder 在旧课本里多是录音机，在音乐课上常是竖笛。看句子才能确定。动词是 record。

senses.en: to start moving or happening faster

ex.en: The cart began to accelerate downhill.
ex.zh: 小车开始向坡下加速。

ex.en: Extra practice can accelerate progress, but only if the student understands each step first.
ex.zh: 额外练习可以加快进步，但前提是学生先弄懂每一步。

tip: accelerate 是动词。名词 acceleration 是物理课里的加速度。反义可用 slow down。

senses.en: related to a cube, or measured in cubes

ex.en: The tank holds two cubic metres.
ex.zh: 水箱能装两立方米。

ex.en: Label the carton 240 cubic centimetres after you measure its length, width and height.
ex.zh: 量完长、宽、高之后，在纸箱上标 240 立方厘米。

tip: 立方米是 a cubic metre。立方体本身是 cube，本库另有一条。

senses.en: a long pole with a sharp point, seen in history or fishing

ex.en: A wooden spear stands in the glass case.
ex.zh: 一支木矛立在玻璃柜里。

ex.en: The coastal chapter shows a fishing spear and explains that families used it to catch fish.
ex.zh: 沿海那一章画着一把鱼叉，并说明人家用它捕鱼。

tip: 高考里 spear 多作名词，出现在历史或渔猎语境。标枪是 javelin，不一定能互换。

senses.en: the rubber ring around a wheel; the British spelling

ex.en: The front tyre is flat.
ex.zh: 前胎瘪了。

ex.en: A worn tyre on the bicycle needs replacing before the long ride, or the rim may bend.
ex.zh: 长途骑行前，自行车上磨旧的轮胎得换掉，不然轮圈可能变形。

tip: tyre 是英式「轮胎」。美式拼写 tire 在本库是另一个词，意思是使疲劳，不要当成这条的美式写法去跳转。

senses.en: a soft white or coloured stick for writing on a board

ex.en: Blue chalk marked the diagram.
ex.zh: 蓝色粉笔在图上做了记号。

ex.en: Please leave a spare stick of chalk on the tray, because the afternoon class still has a diagram to draw.
ex.zh: 请在粉笔槽里留一支备用粉笔，下午的班还要画一张图。

col: a piece of chalk｜一支粉笔
tip: chalk 作粉笔时多不可数。一支说 a piece of chalk 或 a stick of chalk。

senses.en: a religion based on the teachings of the Buddha

ex.en: Buddhism spread along the trade roads.
ex.zh: 佛教沿着商路传播。

ex.en: The history chapter treats Buddhism as a religion with temples, texts, and festivals, and it asks students to write with respect.
ex.zh: 历史这一章把佛教写成有寺院、典籍和节日的宗教，并要求学生行文保持尊重。

col: the spread of Buddhism｜佛教的传播
tip: Buddhism 是宗教名称，首字母大写。信仰者是 Buddhist。课堂里按历史事实来写，保持尊重。

senses.en: to raise the hand to the head as a sign of respect, or to honour someone
that sign

ex.en: Soldiers salute when the flag is raised.
ex.zh: 升旗时士兵敬礼。

ex.en: The letter is a salute to the nurses who stayed on duty through the storm.
ex.zh: 这封信向暴风雨中仍然值班的护士致敬。

tip: salute 可以是军礼，也可以是书面上的致敬。书信开头的称呼是 salutation，比 salute 正式。

senses.en: physical education as a school subject

ex.en: PE is on the field this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午的体育课在操场。

ex.en: Bring trainers for PE, because the hall floor is too smooth for ordinary shoes.
ex.zh: 体育课带运动鞋，礼堂地面太滑，普通鞋不合适。

tip: 考纲里的 PE 就是体育课，读作两个字母。带点的 P.E. 仍在词表里，Zipf 更低，本批不收。
note: 词头按考纲写作 PE。P.E. 是另一条，不在本窗口。

senses.en: a polite title for a man, the full form of Mr

ex.en: Mister Cole coaches the junior team.
ex.zh: 科尔先生执教少年队。

ex.en: Children sometimes say mister when they do not know a man's name, though Mister plus the surname is more polite.
ex.zh: 孩子不知道男士姓名时有时只说 mister，但 Mister 加姓更有礼貌。

col: Mister plus a surname｜先生加姓
tip: 书面几乎总是缩写 Mr，没有句点的美式 Mr 和英式 Mr 都常见。单独喊 Mister 不如加上姓。

senses.en: to make someone feel fresh again
to load a page or screen again

ex.en: A cold drink can refresh you.
ex.zh: 一杯冷饮能让你恢复精神。

ex.en: Refresh the lab page if the graph vanishes, and wait until the new numbers finish loading.
ex.zh: 如果图表消失了，就刷新实验页面，等新的数字加载完。

tip: refresh 可以是休息后恢复精神，也可以是把网页重新载入。茶点常用复数 refreshments。

senses.en: a young person between childhood and adulthood
relating to that age

ex.en: An adolescent needs more sleep than a rumour suggests.
ex.zh: 青少年需要的睡眠比传闻里说的更多。

ex.en: Adolescent growth can be uneven, so the clinic asks students not to compare heights every week.
ex.zh: 青少年的生长可能不均衡，所以校医室请学生不要每周比身高。

tip: adolescent 可以是名词或形容词。时期是 adolescence。语气要尊重，不要把这个年龄写成问题本身。

senses.en: to change food in the stomach, or to understand information fully
a short account of a longer text

ex.en: Walk slowly while you digest a large meal.
ex.zh: 大餐之后慢慢走一走，帮助消化。

ex.en: Digest the article tonight, and tomorrow write a digest of no more than eighty words.
ex.zh: 今晚把这篇文章读懂，明天写一篇不超过八十字的摘要。

tip: 第一义是动词：消化或领会。名词 digest 是文摘、摘要。形容词 digestive，名词 digestion。

senses.en: a disc that stores video or data; the full form of DVD

ex.en: This digital versatile disk holds the photos.
ex.zh: 这张数字多功能光盘存着照片。

ex.en: The library still lends a digital versatile disk of the play, because not every home can stream the file.
ex.zh: 图书馆仍出借这部戏的数字多功能光盘，因为不是每个家庭都能在线播放那个文件。

col: a digital versatile disk｜一张数字多功能光盘
play a digital versatile disk｜播放光盘
tip: 口语说 DVD。全称是 digital versatile disk，目录 id 用连字符。disk 已在库里。不要把它写成 compact disk，那是另一条。

senses.en: a small animal with a bushy tail

ex.en: A squirrel crossed the bike path.
ex.zh: 一只松鼠穿过了自行车道。

ex.en: The park notice asks visitors not to feed a squirrel, because human snacks can make the animals ill.
ex.zh: 公园告示请参观者不要喂松鼠，因为人吃的零食会让它们生病。

tip: squirrel 的复数是 squirrels。考试里它就是动物，不要写成人名。

senses.en: familiar with something because it has happened often

ex.en: I am accustomed to early drills.
ex.zh: 我已经习惯了清早的操练。

ex.en: New students become accustomed to the timetable within a month, once the bells no longer surprise them.
ex.zh: 新同学大约一个月就会习惯课程表，等铃声不再让他们吃惊。

tip: accustomed to 后面接名词或 doing，不接 to do。和 used to do（过去常常）不是同一个结构。

senses.en: a tight roll of tobacco leaves for smoking

ex.en: A cigar is still tobacco.
ex.zh: 雪茄仍然是烟草。

ex.en: The clinic states that a cigar harms the lungs, and the school shop does not sell tobacco to students.
ex.zh: 校医室写明雪茄会伤害肺部，学校商店也不向学生出售烟草。

tip: cigar 比 cigarette 更粗，叶子通常不切碎。健康课只讲危害，不把吸烟写成享受。

senses.en: towards one side, not forwards or back
directed to one side

ex.en: The sign had slipped sideways.
ex.zh: 牌子向一边滑了下去。

ex.en: Turn the sofa sideways if you want it through the door, or the legs will catch on the frame.
ex.zh: 想把沙发搬进门，就把它侧过来，不然腿会卡在门框上。

tip: sideways 多作副词。也可以放在名词前作形容词：a sideways look。没有 sideway 这个常见形式。

senses.en: to fight by holding and trying to throw someone, as a sport
to struggle to deal with a problem

ex.en: They wrestle on a soft mat.
ex.zh: 他们在软垫上摔跤。

ex.en: I still wrestle with this formula, but writing each step in words makes it less frightening.
ex.zh: 我仍在跟这个公式较劲，但把每一步写成文字之后，它就没那么吓人了。

col: wrestle with a problem｜努力解决一个问题
wrestle on a mat｜在垫子上摔跤
tip: wrestle 在体育课是摔跤，要用垫子和规则。wrestle with a problem 是费力思考，不是动手。

senses.en: unable to feel, from cold, pressure, or shock

ex.en: My toes went numb in the snow.
ex.zh: 我的脚趾在雪地里麻了。

ex.en: His fingers were numb after the snowball game, so he warmed them before he tried to write.
ex.zh: 打过雪仗后他的手指麻了，所以他先把手暖热再动笔。

tip: numb 的 b 不发音。可以是身体麻，也可以是震惊后情绪麻木。身体麻得不正常要告诉老师。

senses.en: a tall plant with hard hollow stems

ex.en: Bamboo grows fast beside the wall.
ex.zh: 墙边的竹子长得很快。

ex.en: The craft room uses dried bamboo for frames, and students sand the ends so nobody gets a splinter.
ex.zh: 手工教室用晾干的竹子做框架，学生把末端打磨光滑，免得扎到人。

tip: bamboo 通常不可数，不说 bamboos 来数种类以外的竹子。竹笋是 bamboo shoots。

senses.en: a violent tropical storm in the western Pacific

ex.en: The typhoon closed the ferry.
ex.zh: 台风让渡船停了。

ex.en: During a typhoon, students stay indoors, and the school sends the all-clear before anyone leaves.
ex.zh: 台风期间学生留在室内，学校发出解除信号之后才可以离开。

col: the eye of the typhoon｜台风眼
tip: typhoon 主要用于西北太平洋。大西洋的同类风暴常叫 hurricane。作文里写防护，不写追逐风暴。

senses.en: a light inside a frame, often carried or hung at festivals

ex.en: A red lantern hung over the gate.
ex.zh: 一盏红灯笼挂在门上方。

ex.en: Children carried a paper lantern along the river, and adults kept the candles away from loose sleeves.
ex.zh: 孩子们提着纸灯笼沿河走，大人不让烛火靠近松散的袖子。

tip: Lantern Festival 常用来指元宵节。灯笼里如果有火，例句只讲安全，不讲怎么点火。

senses.en: to provide food for a meeting or party
to provide what a particular group wants

ex.en: The canteen can cater for sixty.
ex.zh: 食堂可以承办六十人的伙食。

ex.en: This club caters to quiet readers as well as students who want the stage.
ex.zh: 这个社团既照顾喜欢安静阅读的人，也照顾想上台的学生。

col: cater for a party｜为聚会承办饮食
cater to a need｜满足一种需要
tip: cater for 多指提供饮食。cater to 常指迎合需要。两种介词不要随便换。

senses.en: a person who makes or alters clothes
to make or adapt something for a particular need

ex.en: The tailor shortened both sleeves.
ex.zh: 裁缝把两只袖子都改短了。

ex.en: Teachers tailor the passage to the class, so beginners read a shorter text with the same question.
ex.zh: 老师按班级改写文章，初学者读更短的文本，问题仍然一样。

col: tailor a course｜按需要调整课程
tip: 名词是做衣服的人。动词 tailor sth to sb 是按对象调整，不限于衣服。

senses.en: a living copy grown from one parent
to grow a living copy from one parent

ex.en: This plant clone matches the parent.
ex.zh: 这株克隆植物和母株一样。

ex.en: In the lab lesson, students read how scientists clone a plant from one cell and then compare it with seed-grown plants.
ex.zh: 实验课上，学生读了科学家如何用一个细胞克隆植物，再把它和种子长成的植株比较。

col: clone a cell｜克隆一个细胞
tip: clone 先是名词「克隆出来的个体」，也可以作动词。课堂里用植物例子即可，不要写成操作步骤。

senses.en: an informal British word for mother
a preserved body from ancient Egypt

ex.en: Mummy packed an extra apple.
ex.zh: 妈妈多装了一个苹果。

ex.en: The museum mummy lies in a glass case, and the label asks visitors not to use a flash.
ex.zh: 博物馆里的木乃伊躺在玻璃柜中，说明请参观者不要用闪光灯。

tip: 英式口语里 mummy 是妈妈，美式常说 mommy。另一个意思是木乃伊。两义都要看上下文。

senses.en: a person who plays the piano

ex.en: The pianist bowed twice.
ex.zh: 钢琴演奏者鞠了两次躬。

ex.en: A young pianist practised the left hand slowly, then joined the school concert on Sunday.
ex.zh: 一位年轻的钢琴演奏者把左手练得很慢，然后参加了周日的学校音乐会。

col: a concert pianist｜音乐会钢琴家
tip: piano 已在库里。pianist 是演奏的人。英式常读 /ˈpiːənɪst/。

senses.en: a meal where people serve themselves
to hit repeatedly, as wind or waves do

ex.en: Lunch is a buffet in the hall.
ex.zh: 午饭在大厅里吃自助餐。

ex.en: Strong wind can buffet a tent, so the camp team ties every rope before anyone sleeps.
ex.zh: 大风会一次次冲击帐篷，所以露营队在大家入睡前把每根绳子都系好。

tip: 自助餐的 buffet 英式常读 /ˈbʊfeɪ/，美式常读 /bəˈfeɪ/。动词「冲击」读 /ˈbʌfɪt/。词条音标按自助餐。

senses.en: liking to meet and talk to people
soon to leave a job or position

ex.en: An outgoing student greeted the guests.
ex.zh: 一个外向的学生向客人打了招呼。

ex.en: The outgoing captain handed her notes to the next captain after the final match.
ex.zh: 卸任的队长在最后一场比赛后把笔记交给了下一任队长。

col: the outgoing president｜即将离任的主席
tip: outgoing 最常见是性格外向。the outgoing chair 是即将离任的主席，和 incoming 相对。

senses.en: a piece of underwear, or a sleeveless jacket

ex.en: He wore a vest under the shirt.
ex.zh: 他在衬衫里面穿了一件汗衫。

ex.en: The orange vest makes the volunteer easy to see when cars pass the school gate.
ex.zh: 橙色背心让志愿者在车辆经过校门时容易被看见。

tip: 英式 vest 常指内衣汗衫。美式 vest 多指西装背心，英式叫 waistcoat。安全背心两边都说 vest。

senses.en: already containing furniture

ex.en: The furnished room includes a desk.
ex.zh: 这间带家具的房间里有一张书桌。

ex.en: A furnished flat costs more each month, but students then need not buy beds before term starts.
ex.zh: 带家具的公寓月租更高，但学生开学前就不必再买床。

col: a furnished flat｜带家具的公寓
tip: furnished 是已经配了家具。家具的总称 furniture 不可数。反义是 unfurnished。

senses.en: a small strong vehicle for rough roads

ex.en: The jeep climbed the farm track.
ex.zh: 吉普车爬上了农场小路。

ex.en: A green jeep carried the tents as far as the mud, and we walked the rest.
ex.zh: 一辆绿色吉普车把帐篷运到泥地边上，剩下的路我们步行。

tip: 课本里的 jeep 指适合烂路的小越野车。它原是商标，考试按普通名词理解即可。

senses.en: words sung or shouted on a few notes
to sing or shout in that way

ex.en: The team chant filled the hall.
ex.zh: 队伍的呼喊声充满了大厅。

ex.en: Students chant the irregular verbs together for two minutes, then write five of them from memory.
ex.zh: 学生把不规则动词齐声念两分钟，再凭记忆写出五个。

col: chant a phrase｜反复念一个短语
tip: chant 可以是运动会上的口号，也可以是反复吟唱。写作时保持尊重，不拿宗教吟唱开玩笑。

senses.en: a hole for a plug, or a hollow that something fits into

ex.en: The lamp plug fits this socket.
ex.zh: 灯的插头适合这个插座。

ex.en: The ball of the shoulder sits in a small socket, which the biology diagram draws without extra labels.
ex.zh: 肩头的圆头嵌在一个小窝里，生物图上没有再加别的标签。

tip: socket 在生活里多是电源插座。解剖里 eye socket 是眼窝，shoulder socket 是肩窝。插头是 plug。

senses.en: the money charged for sending a letter or parcel

ex.en: The postage is higher for a parcel.
ex.zh: 包裹的邮资更高。

ex.en: Check the postage before you queue, because a thick envelope may need an extra stamp.
ex.zh: 排队前先看邮资，厚信封可能要再贴一张邮票。

tip: postage 是寄信的费用，不可数。post 已在库里，可以是邮件、岗位或邮寄。邮票是 postage stamp。

senses.en: without limits or conditions

ex.en: The offer was unconditional.
ex.zh: 这个录取是无条件的。

ex.en: Their support was unconditional, so she could try the new club without having to win first.
ex.zh: 他们的支持没有附加条件，所以她不必先赢一场就可以去试那个新社团。

tip: unconditional offer 在英国升学里是无条件录取。反义 conditional。不要漏掉字母 l 前面的结构。

senses.en: not easily convinced; having doubts

ex.en: I am skeptical of that rumour.
ex.zh: 我对那个传闻持怀疑态度。

ex.en: A skeptical reader checks the date and the source before trusting a surprising claim in the paper.
ex.zh: 抱怀疑态度的读者会先核对日期和出处，再相信报上令人吃惊的说法。

tip: skeptical of 或 skeptical about 都可以。英式拼写是 sceptical，不在本条里另开词头。

senses.en: the region around the South Pole
relating to that region

ex.en: The Antarctic is covered in ice.
ex.zh: 南极地区覆盖着冰。

ex.en: An Antarctic research station recycles water, which the science article explains with a simple diagram.
ex.zh: 南极科考站会循环用水，科学文章用一张简单的图说明了这一点。

tip: the Antarctic 是南极地区。大陆名 Antarctica 多一个 a。北极是 the Arctic，不要写反。首字母通常大写。

senses.en: a wide fast road with no traffic lights

ex.en: The freeway skirts the old town.
ex.zh: 高速公路绕着老城走。

ex.en: Repairs closed one freeway lane, so the team bus left an hour early and still reached the stadium.
ex.zh: 修路封了一条高速车道，球队的车便提前一小时出发，还是赶到了体育场。

tip: freeway 是美式高速公路。英式常用 motorway。它不是市内普通大街。

senses.en: an open space surrounded by buildings

ex.en: Children read in the courtyard.
ex.zh: 孩子们在院子里读书。

ex.en: The hotel courtyard stays quiet at night, which makes it a good place to revise before bed.
ex.zh: 旅馆的庭院夜里很安静，适合睡前复习。

tip: courtyard 是建筑物围起来的院子。court 还可以是法庭或球场，不要只记一个意思。

senses.en: a close-fitting covering for the foot and leg

ex.en: A stocking hung by the fireplace.
ex.zh: 一只长筒袜挂在壁炉边。

ex.en: She bought a thicker stocking for the play, because the stage lights made the thin pair look pale.
ex.zh: 她为演出买了更厚的长筒袜，因为舞台灯会让薄的那双看起来发白。

col: a pair of stockings｜一双长筒袜
tip: stocking 比 sock 长。圣诞传统里也会把礼物放进 a Christmas stocking。通常说 a pair of stockings。

senses.en: an adult female chicken

ex.en: A brown hen guarded twelve eggs.
ex.zh: 一只褐色母鸡守着十二个蛋。

ex.en: A hen in the school garden lays eggs for the cooking class, and students do not chase her.
ex.zh: 学校园子里的母鸡给烹饪课下蛋，学生不去追它。

tip: hen 是母鸡。公鸡是 rooster 或 cock。鸡的总称是 chicken。

senses.en: the force that slows sliding, or disagreement between people

ex.en: Friction keeps the shoes from sliding.
ex.zh: 摩擦力让鞋不打滑。

ex.en: Friction between the two clubs faded after they shared the same practice hour.
ex.zh: 两个社团之间的摩擦在共用同一个训练时段之后消退了。

col: friction between｜……之间的摩擦或不和
tip: 物理里 friction 是摩擦力。人与人之间的摩擦、不和也用这个词。

senses.en: an insect or animal that damages crops or homes
a person who keeps annoying others

ex.en: Aphids are a pest on the beans.
ex.zh: 蚜虫是豆子上的害虫。

ex.en: Calling a classmate a pest is unkind; talk about the behaviour, not a label that sticks.
ex.zh: 把同学叫做讨厌鬼并不友善；要谈具体行为，不要贴一个甩不掉的标签。

tip: pest 在生物课是害虫。用来骂人很不礼貌，作文里要慎重。农药是 pesticide。

senses.en: a word with the same ending sound as another
to have the same ending sound

ex.en: Cat and hat form a rhyme.
ex.zh: cat 和 hat 押韵。

ex.en: Time does not rhyme with team, so the poem's last line had to change before the show.
ex.zh: time 和 team 不押韵，所以演出前诗的最后一行得改。

tip: 名词 rhyme 是韵，动词 rhyme with 是与某个词押韵。nursery rhyme 是童谣。不要写成 rime。

senses.en: to decay through natural change
decay in wood, fruit, or other matter

ex.en: Those apples rot in a warm box.
ex.zh: 那些苹果在暖和的盒子里会烂。

ex.en: Gardeners cut the rot out of the branch so the healthy wood can dry before the next rain.
ex.zh: 园丁把树枝上烂掉的部分削掉，好让健康的木头在下一场雨前晾干。

tip: 动词过去式 rotted。形容词是 rotten，不是 roted。名词 the rot 指已经烂掉的部分。

senses.en: a game in which players mark numbers and shout when they finish

ex.en: Bingo night is in the school hall.
ex.zh: 宾戈之夜在学校礼堂。

ex.en: She shouted bingo only after checking every number against the card in her hand.
ex.zh: 她对照手里的卡片核对了每个数字，才喊宾戈。

tip: 喊 Bingo! 表示这一张卡完成了。它是游戏名，也是那一声喊。

senses.en: extra information at the end of a book
a small organ attached to the large intestine

ex.en: The appendix lists every source.
ex.zh: 附录列出了每一条出处。

ex.en: Pain near the appendix needs a doctor, so he stopped the race and called the school clinic.
ex.zh: 阑尾附近疼就要看医生，于是他停了比赛并联系校医室。

tip: appendix 既是书后附录，也是阑尾。书的复数常用 appendices，器官复数是 appendixes。身体疼痛告诉老师，不要自己判断。

senses.en: a flat plastic disc that stores music or data

ex.en: This compact disk holds the whole concert.
ex.zh: 这张光盘装着整场音乐会。

ex.en: Scratch a compact disk and the last song may jump, so keep it in the case.
ex.zh: 光盘划伤了，最后一首歌可能会跳，所以放回盒子里。

col: a compact disk player｜光盘播放机
tip: 考纲写 compact disk，两个词。缩写 CD 已在库里。disk 的美式拼写也已单列。
note: 词头是两个词 compact disk。目录 id 为 compact-disk。

senses.en: a large black-and-white animal from China

ex.en: The panda chewed a bamboo stalk.
ex.zh: 熊猫嚼着一根竹子。

ex.en: Visitors may photograph the panda, but they must stay behind the rail and must not tap the glass.
ex.zh: 参观者可以给熊猫拍照，但必须站在栏杆外，也不能敲玻璃。

tip: giant panda 是大熊猫。red panda 是小熊猫，不是同一种动物。

senses.en: relating to plants or the scientific study of them

ex.en: The botanical garden opens at nine.
ex.zh: 植物园九点开门。

ex.en: A botanical drawing shows roots as well as flowers, which the art teacher asked the class to notice.
ex.zh: 植物学绘图会把根和花都画出来，美术老师让全班注意这一点。

tip: botanical garden 是植物园。学科是 botany。它是形容词，后面要接名词。
